artifacts.collection_guidance: Acquire before cleanupPeriodDays removes older sessions; preserve original timestamps and SHA-256.
artifacts.rationale: Contains the full conversation, tool calls and tool results needed to reconstruct the agent loop.
artifacts.title: Full Claude Code session transcript

artifacts.rationale: Correlates typed prompts, timestamps and project path.
artifacts.title: Claude prompt history

artifacts.rationale: Indirect prompt injection commonly enters via files/web/tool output; these preserve large results.
artifacts.title: Large tool-result spill files

artifacts.rationale: Shows file state before Claude edits and supports before/after attribution.
artifacts.title: Pre-edit file snapshots

artifacts.rationale: Persistent instructions can be the injection source or change how malicious content is interpreted.
artifacts.title: CLAUDE.md / CLAUDE.local.md instruction files

artifacts.rationale: Defines permissions, hooks, environment and model defaults; precedence matters.
artifacts.title: Claude settings and managed settings

artifacts.rationale: Contains OAuth/app state, trust choices and user/local MCP configurations.
artifacts.title: Claude application/global state

artifacts.rationale: Establishes external tool servers, transports, commands, URLs and scopes available to Claude.
artifacts.title: MCP configuration

artifacts.rationale: Hooks can inspect, deny, transform or trigger actions around tool calls.
artifacts.title: Claude hook definitions/scripts

artifacts.condition: Custom skills, subagents, rules or memory are enabled.
artifacts.rationale: Additional instructions/subagents can create persistent or delegated injection paths.
artifacts.title: Skills, agents, rules and persistent agent memory

artifacts.rationale: Reconstructs shell/runtime context used by tools.
artifacts.title: Session environment/shell snapshots

artifacts.rationale: Preserves large pasted or image content that may contain the injected instruction.
artifacts.title: Paste/image cache

artifacts.condition: Available and relevant to suspicious execution.
artifacts.rationale: Shows planning/debug context and task decomposition.
artifacts.title: Debug logs, plans and task lists

artifacts.condition: Claude operated in a source repository.
artifacts.rationale: Provides independent evidence of code/file modifications.
artifacts.title: Git status/log/reflog/diff and affected repository

artifacts.rationale: Confirms what commands/processes/network activity actually occurred outside the Claude transcript.
artifacts.title: Endpoint process/file/network telemetry

artifacts.condition: Enterprise provider/Purview audit integration is enabled.
artifacts.rationale: Provides an independent copy of prompt/response/file-reference evidence where enterprise logging is enabled.
artifacts.title: Anthropic/enterprise or Purview cloud-side interaction audit

notes: Claude Code application data is plaintext and may contain credentials or sensitive content; restrict evidence access.
Absence of a transcript can be caused by cleanupPeriodDays, CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_PROMPT_HISTORY, --no-session-persistence, or custom CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and must not be interpreted as no activity.
questions: Where did the malicious instruction originate?
Did the instruction enter Claude context?
What tool call or file operation followed?
Did an external side effect or exfiltration occur?
title: Claude Code Prompt Injection / Indirect Prompt Injection
